description_en: Adds an image to a media set and performs AI detection
description_zh: 将图片加入媒体集，并进行AI检测
kebab_example: aliyun imm index-image --project immimagetest --set-id set001 --image-uri oss://imm-test/testcases/face1.jpg --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: IndexImage

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the media set
parameters.name: set_id

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the image.

The OSS URI follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
图片的OSS URI。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: image_uri

parameters.help_en:
The remarks, which is a filter parameter reserved for users to record required information.

In scenarios such as search, you can use the specified value as a search condition with prefix matching. The following are example scenarios:
Store the value as a client permission field, such as AdminGroup/AdminUserA/, to filter user permissions by prefix.
Store the value as a relative path on the client, such as nas://path/to/file
parameters.help_zh:
标记信息，为使用者预留的筛选参数，用于记录所需要的信息。

在搜索等场景下，您可以以前缀匹配的方式将设置的值作为搜索条件，样例场景如下：
作为客户端权限字段存入，例如AdminGroup/AdminUserA/，即可使用前缀过滤用户权限。
作为客户端的相对路径存入，例如nas://path/to/file

The type of the source data. Valid values:

image: The source data type is image.
video: The source data type is video

image：源数据类型为图片。
video：源数据类型为视频
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when SourceType is set to video.

The position of the image frame on the timeline of the source video. The format is `"00000000.010"`, which is %8.3f
parameters.help_zh:
只有当SourceType为video时，此参数才生效。

视频中该图片帧处于源视频的时间轴位置。格式为`"00000000.010"`，即%8.3f
parameters.name: source_position

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint for asynchronous reverse notifications. Image processing results can be asynchronously sent to the invoker through this endpoint. To use this feature, activate Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) first, create a topic and a queue, and configure a subscribe relationship. For more information, see Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) Quick Start overview (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/34412.html).

Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) and Intelligent Media Management must be in the same region
parameters.help_zh:
异步反向通知的Endpoint，图片处理结果可以通过该Endpoint异步通知给调用者。使用此功能需要先开通轻量消息队列（原 MNS）服务，新建topic和queue，并配置订阅关系。具体操作，请参见轻量消息队列（原 MNS）快速入门概述 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/34412.html)。

轻量消息队列（原 MNS）服务和智能媒体管理必须处于同一地域
parameters.name: notify_endpoint
